meta.role: source of the atom-kind substrate rendered by templates/tmpl/gen_substrate.py; hand-maintained; NOT an attestation record
meta.migrated_from: fusenf/specs/vocabulary.json (schema fusenf-vocabulary/1) — attestation fields dropped; deprecated heads dropped; argument types renamed kind → class, individual → instance; field class → kind
meta.types_note: Declared type list (PeTTa convention, capitalized): Atom = unchecked position; Proposition = a statement-forming expression; Instance with sub-types Entity and Event (a symbol carries both its sub-type and Instance); Class; Number; String. Migration mapping from the ad-hoc names: term, assertion -> Proposition; property, verb-lemma, unit -> Class; symbol, reading-tag -> String; var, uncertain -> Atom. A union such as Event|Proposition expands to one declaration per alternative. `out` = the output type of the head's type declaration, set as each kind is reviewed. Proposed types Statement (a statement id = the proof name, reified) and Context (a scope reified), both sub-types of Instance by dual declaration; they belong to the flat context VIEW of scope unless that form becomes canonical. TimeTerm = a reified time instant or period (not named Time: that is the role head) (sub-type of Instance by dual declaration; time predicates Day / Hour / Month / … describe it). Distribution = an engine value (ParticleFromNormal …) allowed where an approximate number is. Level = a degree / proportion level: a symbol from a closed label set (very, excessive, most, half — declared Level by the emitter) or a term standing in for one ((forKind class), (Fraction n d)).
meta.statement_form: Every atom is carried as a statement (: <proof-name> <atom> <tv>), tv = (STV strength confidence) or another engine truth value. The carrier is not an atom kind: ':' is never type-declared (it is also PeTTa's type-declaration head) and the truth value is declared by the engine, not by this substrate.

AccordingTo.gloss: Evidential attribution: seals P and names its source ("according to X, P").

Again.gloss: Repetitive/restitutive presupposition: a prior same-type event happened.

Agent.gloss: Volitional doer / subject of an action. A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

Already.gloss: The eventuality happened earlier than expected.

Also.gloss: Additive focus particle ('also / too / as well'). Filler as for Only; also the carrier of either / neither; the additive presupposition is recorded, never asserted.

Although.gloss: Concessive connective 'although'. Order: (Connective main-clause-eventuality subordinate-eventuality); a copular endpoint is reified as a state witness. The head is the surface connective itself, never normalized.

AmongMost.gloss: Top-stratum membership: one of the ADJ-est members of a class. Order: (AmongMost scale X class).

And.gloss: Conjunction bundle; one fact, one truth value.

AsAResult.gloss: Causal connective 'as a result'. Order: (Connective main-clause-eventuality subordinate-eventuality); a copular endpoint is reified as a state witness. The head is the surface connective itself, never normalized.

Because.gloss: Causal connective 'because'. Order: (Connective main-clause-eventuality subordinate-eventuality); a copular endpoint is reified as a state witness. The head is the surface connective itself, never normalized.

Before.gloss: Canonical ordering: the first eventuality precedes the second, an eventuality or a time instance (the catalog renders after as Before with the arguments swapped).

BeforeBy.gloss: Measured temporal gap: the first eventuality or time instance precedes the second (an eventuality, or a time instance such as the text's reference time now) by n units; 0 units = the same period (today = 0 day before now).

Beneficiary.gloss: 'for …' oblique: only a party the event is done for the benefit of (incl. acting in someone's place); a 'for' naming the ground, prize or exchange is the preposition-named (For …) oblique instead. A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

But.gloss: Adversative connective 'but'. Order: (Connective main-clause-eventuality subordinate-eventuality); a copular endpoint is reified as a state witness. The head is the surface connective itself, never normalized.

Can.gloss: A specific subject's capability on this event. Target form: operator over the sealed clause (-> Proposition Proposition); the tag form (-> Event Proposition) is legacy, kept only until the re-parse.

Cardinality.gloss: Exact size of a group (a point value, native integer). Order: (… group n); an approximate size may be a distribution.

CardinalityAtLeast.gloss: Lower bound on a group's size. Order: (… group n); an approximate size may be a distribution.

CardinalityAtMost.gloss: Upper bound on a group's size. Order: (… group n); an approximate size may be a distribution.

CardinalityPhrase.gloss: Records a vague count phrase on a group ('several', 'dozens'). Surface record: a literal string; excluded from the faithful mining view.

Cleft.gloss: It-cleft / pseudo-cleft focus marker. Filler = the clefted phrase; the backgrounded clause is the asserted prejacent.

CoAgent.gloss: Animate co-participant named by a comitative phrase ('with John'). A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

Compute.gloss: Hard-numeric arithmetic/comparison test on bound integers. Engine form inside rules and queries (Compute op (args) -> result); positions unchecked. Lowering target: templates emit the generic comparison; the lowering produces this form.

ConditionalProperty.gloss: A class-level property restricted to a place, a time or a circumstance: the class as found there has the property (otters are rare in Norfolk; cranes are rare in winter). Order: (ConditionalProperty class property restriction); the restriction is an entity (a place, a thing) or a class (a time, a circumstance). Opaque like KindProperty: distributes to no member. A member-level property under a condition is a parser-emitted rule instead, never this atom.

Consequently.gloss: Causal connective 'consequently'. Order: (Connective main-clause-eventuality subordinate-eventuality); a copular endpoint is reified as a state witness. The head is the surface connective itself, never normalized.

Coref.gloss: Hypothesis that two mentions denote one entity; STV = probability of identity. Base of the resolved-entity view. A mention type is pending.

Counterfactual.gloss: Sealed subjunctive conditional: antecedent and consequent, neither asserted.

Day.gloss: Day-of-month of a time instance: (Day t 6). Legacy constructor form (Day 6) kept until the re-parse.

Degree.gloss: Intensity level of a property on an entity. Order: (Degree entity scale level); the level is the degree word as written, declared Level (very, slightly, too, enough, almost), or (forClass class) for a comparison class. Whether the property's positive atom is asserted beside it is the parse's decision: an intensifier, a downtoner, too and enough keep it; almost, nearly, all_but and forClass do not.

Despite.gloss: Concessive connective 'despite'. Order: (Connective main-clause-eventuality subordinate-eventuality); a copular endpoint is reified as a state witness. The head is the surface connective itself, never normalized.

Directive.gloss: Seals a positive imperative's commanded eventuality.

Duration.gloss: Licensed duration-adverb slot: the surface adverb lemma on an eventuality. A surface-record-like slot (vague extent); the measured form is (Measure e duration n unit).

During.gloss: The inner eventuality is nested inside the outer one, an eventuality or a time period (during the meeting, while Yusra sang, until dawn is End).

End.gloss: Interval end point of an eventuality: (End e r), r a time instance or the eventuality it stops with (until Yusra arrived).

Entails.gloss: The event's sealed Theme holds: the parser's record that the matrix verb is implicative (manage, make, let, begin, remember to …). A background rule derives the Theme's content at the event's tense; nothing in the parse asserts it. Order: (Entails matrix-event).

Equivalence.gloss: Symmetric equivalence of two propositions; strength = P(P and Q | P or Q). The reversible-packaging link; lowers to the engine's BiImplication.

Even.gloss: Scalar focus particle ('even'). Filler as for Only; the scalar presupposition is recorded, never asserted.

EvenThough.gloss: Concessive connective 'even though'. Order: (Connective main-clause-eventuality subordinate-eventuality); a copular endpoint is reified as a state witness. The head is the surface connective itself, never normalized.

Every.gloss: Periodic recurrence: the eventuality recurs every n units ((Every e 1 day) for every day / daily / every morning, (Every e 2 week) for every two weeks); the slot of a schedule (morning, a weekday) is a Time on the same eventuality.

Experiencer.gloss: Subject of a stative predication — psych state or predicate-adjective state. A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

Extent.gloss: How much an eventuality holds: a degree adverb on a verb, kept as written and declared Level (deeply, really, barely, sharply, a_lot). Order: (Extent event level). The event stays asserted; an approximator on a verb (almost fell) is not an Extent.

FoldAll.gloss: Aggregate fold across all pattern matches (e.g. sum of cardinalities). Engine aggregate form; positions unchecked. Lowering target: templates emit the generic aggregate (count / sum over a pattern); the lowering produces this form.

Forbid.gloss: Seals a negative imperative's forbidden eventuality. RETIRE: under explicit scope a negative imperative is (Directive (Not P)), parallel to (Obligated (Not P)); declaration kept only until the re-parse.

Fraction.gloss: Exact fraction / percentage term, numerator over denominator. A value term, not a statement: stands in the level slot of ProportionOf ("two-thirds of", "37% of" as (Fraction 37 100), never reduced).

Goal.gloss: Non-recipient destination / 'to …' oblique (whither); the addressee of a transfer or communication is Recipient, never Goal. A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

GreaterThan.gloss: Graded P(value > N) over a distribution magnitude. Generic meaning (a comparison, graded over a distribution); engine-named.

GroupOf.gloss: The members of this group individual are of that class.

Holder.gloss: Subject of a possession/relational state only (own, have, lack). A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

Hour.gloss: Clock hour (24-hour) of a time instance: (Hour t 15); an approximate hour may be a distribution. Legacy constructor form (Hour 15) kept until the re-parse.

Implication.gloss: Inference rule: a Premises term implies a Conclusions term.

InContext.gloss: Membership of a statement in a scope context: the flat (unnested) form of scope, where a scope operator becomes a predicate of the context — (Might c1) (InContext f1 c1). Structural link, not a status; absent from the canonical operator form, present in the generated flat view.

InOrderTo.gloss: Purpose connective 'in order to'. Order: (InOrderTo action-event aim); the aim is the purpose clause SEALED as one term (an aim is not an occurrence: nothing of it is asserted on its own), its actor the action's subject.

Inheritance.gloss: A class/property is a subclass of another class/property.

Instrument.gloss: The means an action is performed by ('with a knife') or a 'via / by way of' route or channel: a tool, substance or conduit, never a person (a person 'with' whom is CoAgent). A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

Interpretation.gloss: Transport wrapper marking a statement as belonging to one reading of a multi-reading parse: (Interpretation rN (: name expr stv)). The legacy canonicalizer dissolves it (split-before-canonicalize); the chainer accepts it as a reading-scoped assertion and answers per reading or as a marginal with the confidence discounted by the reading share. Typed form: (Interpretation reading-tag statement-id); the legacy inline form wraps the whole statement and is unchecked. Under the flat scope view a reading is a Context and this becomes (Reading c) + (InContext f c).

ClassProperty.gloss: Non-distributing property of a class/population as a whole. Order: (ClassProperty class property). Opaque: distributes to no member. Emitted by the class-property template; the frozen prompt line writes it as KindProperty.

KindProperty.gloss: The legacy name of ClassProperty (the frozen prompt line and its corpora write it); kept until the re-parse so those parses still type-check. Order: (KindProperty class property).

LikelihoodPhrase.gloss: Surface record of a likelihood adverb ("probably", "likely", "definitely", "certainly") on the eventuality whose clause carries the corresponding STV strength band — traceability and reversibility of the word-to-strength mapping. Excluded from the faithful mining view like the other surface records.

LocatedIn.gloss: Static location of an entity ('X is in Y') — as against the event oblique Location. Order: (LocatedIn entity place); the location of an EVENT is the role Location.

Location.gloss: Where the eventuality holds ('in/at/on …'). A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

Manner.gloss: Adverbial manner of the eventuality. A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

Measure.gloss: Puts a magnitude and unit on an entity's dimension. Order: (… entity-or-event dimension magnitude unit); an approximate magnitude may be a distribution.

MeasureAtLeast.gloss: Lower-bounded measure. Order: (… entity-or-event dimension magnitude unit); an approximate magnitude may be a distribution.

MeasureAtMost.gloss: Upper-bounded measure. Order: (… entity-or-event dimension magnitude unit); an approximate magnitude may be a distribution.

MeasureBy.gloss: Delta of a scalar-change eventuality: how much the dimension changed. Order: (… event dimension magnitude unit).

MeasureFrom.gloss: Start value of a scalar change ("from X"). Order: (… event dimension magnitude unit).

MeasureTo.gloss: End value of a scalar change ("to Y", "rose to 6.1%"). Order: (… event dimension magnitude unit).

Member.gloss: An individual belongs to a class or holds a property.

Might.gloss: Epistemic possibility ('might / may'). Target form: operator over the sealed clause (-> Proposition Proposition); the tag form (-> Event Proposition) is legacy, kept only until the re-parse.

Minute.gloss: Clock minute of a time instance: (Minute t 30). Legacy constructor form kept until the re-parse.

Month.gloss: Calendar month of a time instance, the month name as a class of time periods: (Month t july). Legacy constructor form (Month july) kept until the re-parse.

MonthNumber.gloss: Seeded lexicon fact giving a month name its ordinal number. Background fact (seeded), never parser output; month names are classes of time periods.

More.gloss: X exceeds Y on a scale (reified comparative ordering). Order: (More scale X Y) = X exceeds Y. X and Y are instances, or classes in a class-level comparison ((More hard basalt chalk)).

MoreBy.gloss: Comparative with a measured gap: X exceeds Y by n units. Order: (MoreBy scale X Y magnitude unit). X and Y are instances, or classes in a class-level comparison ((More hard basalt chalk)).

Most.gloss: Superlative: X is the most ADJ member of a class. Order: (Most scale X class).

Must.gloss: Epistemic necessity ('must'-inference). Target form: operator over the sealed clause (-> Proposition Proposition); the tag form (-> Event Proposition) is legacy, kept only until the re-parse.

Name.gloss: Records a named individual's surface name string. Surface record: a literal string; excluded from the faithful mining view.

Not.gloss: Explicit negation over a proposition. The top-level form lowers natively (the engine canonicalizes (Not X) to X at strength 1-s); nested forms (under a modal, a particle or a seal) are the lowering's work.

Obligated.gloss: Deontic obligation on a specific act. Target form: operator over the sealed clause (-> Proposition Proposition); the tag form (-> Event Proposition) is legacy, kept only until the re-parse.

Only.gloss: Exclusive focus particle ('only / just / solely'). Filler = the focused constituent: an instance (subject / object focus) or a class lemma (VP / predicate focus); the prejacent is asserted normally; no exclusion rule is emitted (closure-gated).

Or.gloss: Inclusive disjunction: at least one disjunct holds, unspecified which.

Ordinal.gloss: The entity's rank n on an ordering scale. Order: (Ordinal entity rank scale); the scale may be a verb lemma ("first to respond").

PartOf.gloss: Part/component (or named member) of a whole. Order: (PartOf part whole); eventualities may have parts.

ParticleFromNormal.gloss: Approximate magnitude as a normal distribution: mean and sigma. Generic meaning (an approximate magnitude, "about 200 kg"); engine-named; other engines get it by lowering.

Patient.gloss: Object the action creates, destroys, consumes or physically changes. A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

Pending.gloss: NPI 'yet' particle: expected but not yet (under negation or a question); the expectation is recorded, never asserted — its own positive atom outside any denial. Renamed from the arity-1 sense of Yet to free Yet for the adversative connective.

Permitted.gloss: Deontic permission on a specific act. Target form: operator over the sealed clause (-> Proposition Proposition); the tag form (-> Event Proposition) is legacy, kept only until the re-parse.

Possession.gloss: Possessed-to-possessor link (ownership, kinship, loose association). Order: (Possession possessed possessor). The possessive construction (NP-internal); the verb "own / have" is an event with Holder and Theme, and their relation is a background rule, never a parser collapse.

Precludes.gloss: The event's sealed Theme does not hold: the parser's record that the matrix verb is negatively implicative (fail, forget to, prevent, keep from). A background rule derives the Theme's negation at the event's tense. Order: (Precludes matrix-event).

Probably.gloss: Epistemic probability ('probably'). Target form: operator over the sealed clause (-> Proposition Proposition); the tag form (-> Event Proposition) is legacy, kept only until the re-parse. RETIRE: the likelihood becomes the clause statement's STV strength (band per word, in the template), and the surface word is kept by a LikelihoodPhrase surface record; declaration kept only until the re-parse.

ProportionOf.gloss: The portion's proportion of a definite whole. Order: (ProportionOf portion whole level); the level is a symbol from a closed label set (most, half, …), declared String-typed by the emitter. The level is a Level label (most, half) or a (Fraction n d) term.

PurposeOf.gloss: Canonical ask-relation: purpose/goal of a focus event. Order: (PurposeOf goal-eventuality focus-event). Observation when the text states it; derived by a seeded bridge from InOrderTo / To otherwise — the origin field tells which.

QuantifierPhrase.gloss: Records the surface quantifier word beside the strength it set. Surface record: a literal string; excluded from the faithful mining view. RETIRE: the catalog no longer emits it — the word stays in the instance record (range.quantifier, class-statement.quantifier, frequency.word / level), reachable from any statement through its instance link, so it is provenance beside the knowledge base, not an atom in it; its original job (telling an explicit word from a bare generic at the same strength) is done by the confidence; declaration kept for the legacy records until the re-parse.

Quarter.gloss: Calendar / fiscal quarter of a time instance: (Quarter t 3) beside (Year t 2003). Legacy constructor form (Quarter 3 2003) kept until the re-parse.

Question.gloss: Seals an embedded constituent (wh-) question with its wh-word. The wh-word is a bare symbol that doubles as the gap filler inside the body, so its position is unchecked.

ReasonFor.gloss: Canonical ask-relation: reason for a focus event. Order: (ReasonFor reason-eventuality focus-event). Observation when the text states it; derived by a seeded bridge from Because / Since otherwise — the origin field tells which.

Recipient.gloss: Goal of a transfer (indirect object / 'to'); the addressee of a communication. A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

RestOf.gloss: Flags a portion as the remainder of a definite whole. Order: (RestOf remainder whole).

Result.gloss: Links a change event to its result. Order: (Result event result). The result is the outcome proposition as a sealed term in the catalog form ((Result sk_become_1 (Member teodor locksmith))); that the outcome holds afterwards is a background rule (the catalog's seeded rules), not a flat emission; the legacy form linked a reified result-state eventuality.

SameDegree.gloss: Equative: X is as ADJ as Y. Order: (SameDegree scale X Y). X and Y are instances, or classes in a class-level comparison ((More hard basalt chalk)).

ScaleOpposite.gloss: Links the two poles of one gradable dimension. Background fact (seeded), never parser output.

Similarity.gloss: Symmetric, non-transitive similarity between two classes; the approximate-abstraction link. Never chained into equivalence classes.

Since.gloss: Causal connective 'since'. Order: (Connective main-clause-eventuality subordinate-eventuality); a copular endpoint is reified as a state witness. The head is the surface connective itself, never normalized.

So.gloss: Causal connective 'so'. Order: (Connective main-clause-eventuality subordinate-eventuality); a copular endpoint is reified as a state witness. The head is the surface connective itself, never normalized.

SoAsTo.gloss: Purpose connective 'so as to'. Order: (SoAsTo action-event aim); the aim is the purpose clause SEALED as one term (an aim is not an occurrence: nothing of it is asserted on its own), its actor the action's subject.

Source.gloss: Origin / 'from …' oblique. A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

Start.gloss: Interval start point of an eventuality: (Start e r), r a time instance described by Day / Hour / Year … atoms, or the eventuality it starts with (since the audit).

Still.gloss: Continuative: the eventuality still holds (positive counterpart of cessation).

Stimulus.gloss: Object of a psych/perception state. A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event. A sealed clause as the stimulus describes an action the experiencer likes, enjoys or fears doing (likes to send quilts).

SubsetOf.gloss: A quantified subset group of a definite superset group. Order: (SubsetOf subset-group superset-group); both are group individuals.

Symmetric.gloss: Tags a relation head as mutual by meaning. The argument is a relation HEAD symbol (an open-class mutual predicate such as Friend); heads are not a type, so the position is unchecked. Background fact about the vocabulary.

Theme.gloss: Object acquired, transferred, moved, possessed, perceived or evaluated unchanged. A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event. Filler: an entity, an actual eventuality (aspectual / continuation complements: "stopped knitting", "kept falling"), or a sealed proposition (attitude / control complements).

Therefore.gloss: Causal connective 'therefore'. Order: (Connective main-clause-eventuality subordinate-eventuality); a copular endpoint is reified as a state witness. The head is the surface connective itself, never normalized.

Thus.gloss: Causal connective 'thus'. Order: (Connective main-clause-eventuality subordinate-eventuality); a copular endpoint is reified as a state witness. The head is the surface connective itself, never normalized.

Time.gloss: Locates an eventuality at a time point or recurrence slot. Filler = a time instance (deictic constants such as yesterday / now are declared Time by the emitter). A compound-action class symbol under the compound decomposition ((Patient use_crosswalk crosswalk)) is declared both Class and Event.

TimeAtLeast.gloss: Lower-bounded (earliest) time of an eventuality, inclusive: (TimeAtLeast e r), r a time instance or an eventuality (no earlier than Monday).

TimeAtMost.gloss: Upper-bounded (latest) time of an eventuality, inclusive: (TimeAtMost e r), r a time instance or an eventuality (by Monday, by the audit).

TimesAs.gloss: Multiplicative comparative: X is <factor> times as ADJ as Y. Order: (TimesAs scale X Y factor). X and Y are instances, or classes in a class-level comparison ((More hard basalt chalk)).

TimesPer.gloss: Rate recurrence: the eventuality recurs n times per unit (twice a week: (TimesPer e 2 week)); a bare count is Times, a period Every.

To.gloss: Purpose connective 'to'. Order: (To action-event aim); the aim is the purpose clause SEALED as one term (an aim is not an occurrence: nothing of it is asserted on its own), its actor the action's subject.

Weekday.gloss: Weekday of a time instance, the weekday name as a class: (Weekday t tuesday). Legacy constructor form kept until the re-parse.

WeekdayNumber.gloss: Seeded lexicon fact giving a weekday name its number (monday=1). Background fact (seeded), never parser output.

Whether.gloss: Seals an embedded polar question under the matrix verb's Theme.

WithinLast.gloss: Backward window: the eventuality falls within the last n units. RETIRE: the catalog composes it from a time instance at the offset and a bound — (BeforeBy t now n unit) (TimeAtLeast e t) — and the forward window (within n units) the same way with TimeAtMost; no stored parse uses it; declaration kept only until the re-parse.

Xor.gloss: Exclusive disjunction: exactly one of two disjuncts holds.

Year.gloss: Calendar year of a time instance: (Year t 2026). Legacy constructor form (Year 2026) kept until the re-parse.

Yet.gloss: Adversative inter-clause connective 'X, yet Y' (main, sub), like But. The unary particle sense is now Pending; its legacy declarations are kept until the re-parse. Order: (Connective main-clause-eventuality subordinate-eventuality); a copular endpoint is reified as a state witness. The head is the surface connective itself, never normalized.

can.gloss: Builds the reified capability property term from a verb lemma; a class-valued term kept nested: (Inheritance bird (can fly)), (Inheritance swimmer (can swim)); on an individual, (Member x (can fly)) is the inherited form.

forClass.gloss: Comparison-class marker: ADJ relative to the norm for a class. A value term, not a statement: stands in the level slot of Degree.

obligated.gloss: Builds the reified obligation property term from an action (possibly a compound verb_object symbol); a class-valued term kept nested: (Inheritance member (obligated pay)); weak "should" at strength 0.7.

permitted.gloss: Builds the reified permission property term from an action; a class-valued term kept nested: (Inheritance visitor (permitted enter)); a class-level prohibition is the same term at strength 0.0.

Times.gloss: Count of occurrences of the eventuality with no unit: (Times e 2) for twice, (Times e 3) for three times. A count per unit is TimesPer, a period Every.

open_class.policy: Lexical relation heads the prompt licenses generically rather than enumerating: class-level relations, symmetric/reciprocal relations, nominalization relations. They cannot be checked by name — the validator checks position and arity only. Never frozen: these are the primary consolidation targets. Obliques are ALSO open class: prompt.txt attaches an oblique under a head named after its own preposition/adverb, so the head set cannot be enumerated in advance. `oblique_prepositions` lists the English prepositions that may therefore appear as an arity-2 head; an UpperCamelCase head that is NOT one of them is still flagged.
positions: head of a class-level relation atom, e.g. (Carry mosquito malaria)
head of a symmetric relation atom accompanied by (Symmetric <head>)
head of a nominalization class-relation, e.g. (Build dam_builder dam)
skolem-function head (sk_<verb>) in a scope construction, e.g. (sk_y $x)

oblique_signature.note: every oblique preposition head attaches a participant to an eventuality, to an entity in a bare position clause ((Under sk_gazetteer_1 sk_lectern_1)), or to a compound property / action class under the compound decomposition; the preposition actually used is the head
